<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Functional\Api;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Test\WebTestCase;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Test __API_TEST_CLASS__.
 *
 * @category Functional Tests
 *
 * @author __AUTHOR__
 */
final class __API_TEST_CLASS__ extends WebTestCase
{
  // #region Methods
  /**
   * Method testEndpointRequiresAuthentication.
   *
   * Tests that the endpoint requires authentication.
   */
  #[Test]
  public function testEndpointRequiresAuthentication(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request('__HTTP_METHOD__', '__URI__');

    $statusCode = $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode();

    self::assertContains(
      needle: $statusCode,
      haystack: [Response::HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED, Response::HTTP_FORBIDDEN],
      message: 'Expected 401 or 403 status code for unauthenticated request, got ' . $statusCode,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Method testEndpointExistsBehindAuthentication.
   *
   * Tests that the route exists and is not accidentally exposed as a 404.
   */
  #[Test]
  public function testEndpointExistsBehindAuthentication(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request('__HTTP_METHOD__', '__URI__');

    $statusCode = $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode();

    self::assertNotSame(
      expected: Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND,
      actual: $statusCode,
      message: 'Security endpoint should exist and not return 404.',
    );
  }

  /**
   * Method testRateLimitedEndpointReturnsTooManyRequestsWhenApplicable.
   *
   * Tests the 429 contract only when the endpoint is protected by a limiter.
   */
  #[Test]
  public function testRateLimitedEndpointReturnsTooManyRequestsWhenApplicable(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    // Replace this placeholder with the calls needed to exhaust the configured limiter.
    __RATE_LIMIT_SETUP__

    $client->request(
      method: '__RATE_LIMIT_METHOD__',
      uri: '__RATE_LIMIT_URI__',
      server: __RATE_LIMIT_SERVER__,
      content: __RATE_LIMIT_CONTENT__,
    );

    $statusCode = $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode();

    self::assertContains(
      needle: $statusCode,
      haystack: [Response::HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, Response::HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED, Response::HTTP_FORBIDDEN],
      message: 'Expected a denial or throttling response, got ' . $statusCode,
    );
  }
  // #endregion
}
